lines.en: My copper joints turn notch by notch.
This fresh copper is too bright.
A spot of verdigris weighs my step.

lines.zh: 我从铜块里走出来，量过尺寸。
lines.en: I came out of copper blocks.

lines.zh: 每一步都敲响地面，像按钮。
lines.en: Each step rings like a button.

lines.zh: 南瓜头有点歪，看不清路。
lines.en: My pumpkin head tilts. The road blurs.
The lightning rod rides my back.

lines.zh: 氧化让我变绿，也让我变慢。
lines.en: Oxidizing greens me. It also slows me.
I walk toward the nearest copper button.

lines.zh: 脚下草皮被铜趾压出印。
lines.en: Copper toes press prints into the turf.
I do not run. My joints refuse.
Wind hisses through my verdigris.
I have circled this patch three times.
Copper is heavier than flesh.

lines.zh: 站着也算按了一次按钮。
lines.en: Standing still also counts as pressing.
I am counting breaths, but I have no lungs.
The copper changes color in the air.
Someone put a pumpkin on my head.

lines.zh: 蜜脾的味道能让铜慢下来。
lines.en: Honeycomb slows the rust down.

lines.zh: 斧头擦过的地方，我又亮了。
lines.en: Where the axe scraped, I shine again.

lines.zh: 我听见雷声，背上的针在等。
lines.en: I hear thunder. The rod is waiting.
Sand is grinding inside my joints.

lines.zh: 铜锭是我身上掉下的东西。
lines.en: Copper ingots are pieces of me.

lines.zh: 我按住一个按钮，等它弹起。
lines.en: I hold a button down and wait.
The sun heats my copper skin.

lines.zh: 我数到七，又忘了数到几。
lines.en: I count to seven and lose count.
Silence is part of being copper.
I am waiting for the next click.
Your hand. Are you going to press me?
Why are you holding that axe?

lines.zh: 这个角度，你能看见我的锈。
lines.en: From here you can see my rust.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，按钮会误触。
lines.en: Too close. You might trip a button.
You smell faintly of copper ingots.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，像记住一个按钮。
lines.en: I will remember you like a button.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比我的南瓜亮。
lines.en: Your eyes are brighter than my pumpkin.
Do not touch my face with honeycomb.
Are you here to scrape my rust?
Are you waiting for lightning too?

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一根避雷针。
lines.en: I watch you the way I watch a rod.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的频率，我记下了。
lines.en: I have recorded how often you blink.
A dent. I can still press.
Not the joints. That is the thin part.
Copper does not hurt. It rings.

lines.zh: 这一下震掉了我一层锈。
lines.en: That blow shook off a layer of rust.
My pumpkin cracked along one side.

lines.zh: 你打得很准，可惜铜很厚。
lines.en: Good aim. Shame copper is thick.
Hit me again and I fall apart.
I can hear something loose inside.

lines.zh: 斧头砍铜，是另一种声音。
lines.en: An axe on copper sounds different.
I step back and hide the dent.
That copper button is calling me.
Offer me copper and I will come.
Are you trying to lure me with a pumpkin?
I do not eat. I only want to press.
That sound is a button springing back.
I know the smell of copper blocks.
Raising honeycomb will not work on me.
Let me press it once. Just once.

lines.zh: 那个按钮在闪，我看见了。
lines.en: The button is flashing. I see it.

lines.zh: 我承认，我抗拒不了咔哒声。
lines.en: I admit it. I cannot resist clicking.
Hit me and the copper dents.
You knocked me off my line.
My pumpkin head bumped into you.

lines.zh: 别推，我站得比你以为的稳。
lines.en: Do not push. I stand steadier than I look.
A joint jammed. Let me pass.
Copper on copper makes a thin sound.
You chipped some verdigris off me.
My weight sits low. I will not fall.
I will count that as your press.

lines.zh: 退开，我要重新对准方向。
lines.en: Step back. I need to realign.
Copper golems do not have children.

lines.zh: 我们是被拼出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: We are assembled, not born.
A partner? I would rather find a button.

lines.zh: 两只铜傀儡只会抢按钮。
lines.en: Two golems would only fight over buttons.

lines.zh: 繁殖这事写在别人身上。
lines.en: Breeding is written on other creatures.

lines.zh: 我身上的锈不会传给谁。
lines.en: My rust cannot be passed to anyone.

lines.zh: 你要造第二个我，用铜块。
lines.en: If you want a second me, use copper.

lines.zh: 南瓜只有一个，我也只有一个。
lines.en: There is one pumpkin. There is one me.
Do not mention offspring in my hearing.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡才管村子，我只管按钮。
lines.en: Iron golems guard villages. I guard buttons.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块铜，揣进胸腔。
lines.en: I pick up copper and tuck it inside.
Copper ingots on the ground are mine.
This button came loose. I keep it.
My hands are too hard. I crush things.

lines.zh: 我把它放进铜块做的口袋。
lines.en: I drop it into my copper pocket.
Even your scraped verdigris is useful.

lines.zh: 我只会捡会咔哒的东西。
lines.en: I only collect things that click.

lines.zh: 这块铜，是从我身上掉的吧。
lines.en: This copper fell off me, I think.

lines.zh: 我捡起南瓜籽，没用，放回去。
lines.en: Pumpkin seeds? Useless. I put them back.

lines.zh: 拾取是我的第二种本能。
lines.en: Picking up is my second instinct.
That button is mine to press.
I smell copper on your armor.
Locked on: the shining copper face.
You are standing in front of my button.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的斧头了。
lines.en: I saw the axe in your hand.
Who is touching my lightning rod?
Your plating is metal as well.

lines.zh: 我要去把那个按钮按下去。
lines.en: I am going to press that button.
You stepped on my copper block.
Locking on is habit, not hostility.
I will walk at you on three.
Are you taking apart my pumpkin?
That hand. Keep it off the button.

lines.zh: 目标很小，只是一个凸起。
lines.en: The target is small. Just a bump.
I stare at the button and at you.
Copper reflects light. You cannot hide.
My pumpkin eyes do not blink.
You step back. I step forward.
I am waiting for you to press something.
At this distance I can reach you.
My copper joints are warming up.
Patience. I must line up first.
Your breathing changed. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我锁定的是那块铜，不是你。
lines.en: I am locked on copper, not on you.
Your shadow is covering the button.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，一步一格。
lines.en: I count your steps, one square each.

lines.zh: 雷要来了，我背上的针竖着。
lines.en: Thunder is coming. My rod stands up.

lines.zh: 我瞄准的是凸起的那一点。
lines.en: I aim at the one raised point.
My copper fist lands with a thud.
This is a press, not a punch.

lines.zh: 我的拳头有二十点的重量。
lines.en: My fist carries twenty points of weight.
You just got hit by copper.
The joint creaked, but it connected.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，只擅长按。
lines.en: I am bad at fighting. Good at pressing.
My pumpkin head hits you first.
Copper knuckles crack on your armor.

lines.zh: 就一下，不会再来第二下。
lines.en: One hit. I will not swing twice.
My hand is blunt. Sorry about that.

lines.zh: 你退开，按钮就露出来了。
lines.en: Move back and the button shows again.

lines.zh: 打你的时候，锈掉了一小块。
lines.en: A fleck of rust fell off my swing.
This punch is dusted with verdigris.
Too hard. My joint popped out.
Copper block, pumpkin, lightning rod.

lines.zh: 我从铜方块里被拼起来。
lines.en: I was assembled out of copper blocks.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，看见的是雷云。
lines.en: First thing I saw was a storm cloud.

lines.zh: 我的胸口还留着手工的痕。
lines.en: My chest still shows the maker's seams.
Whoever built me gave me no mouth.
The moment I landed, I looked for buttons.
The copper is fresh. No rust yet.

lines.zh: 南瓜套上之前，我是空的。
lines.en: Before the pumpkin, I was hollow.
I heard clicking somewhere far away.
My maker walked off without a word.
My first step crushed the grass.

lines.zh: 身体里还响着拼装的回声。
lines.en: The echo of assembly still rings inside.
I counted my legs. There are two.

lines.zh: 铜的凉意从脚底升上来。
lines.en: Cold copper rises through my feet.
Too hot. My copper is softening.
Fell hard. A joint slipped out.

lines.zh: 铜在水里生绿，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water turns my copper green. I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，零件散了一地。
lines.en: The blast threw my pieces everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭插在铜面上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my copper.
Magic makes my copper go numb.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可铜也会耗尽。
lines.en: I do not eat, but copper runs down.

lines.zh: 雷打中避雷针，我亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning struck the rod. I lit up.
There are no buttons in the void.
